idea-plugin.name: Gradle Version Guard
idea-plugin.description:
Gradle Version Guard protects your machine from disk bloat by keeping all your Android and Kotlin Multiplatform projects aligned to a unified version baseline.

Features:
  • Pre-Sync Drift Detection: Inspects libs.versions.toml, gradle-wrapper.properties, and gradle.properties before Gradle Sync begins.
  • Interactive Alignment Dialog: Lists all dependencies that differ from your machine baseline with clean diffs.
  • 1-Click Alignment & Sync: Automatically updates versions, wrapper distributions, and caching flags with automated safety backups.
  • Zero Dependencies: Bridges with local Gradle Cache Manager or reads ~/.gradle/gcm-baseline.json directly.

action.description: Checks current project versions against the machine-wide shared cache baseline
